question.problem:
A discrete random variable $X$ has the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below.  Find $\text{E}[\sqrt[3]{X}].$

| $x$ | $8$ | $27$ | $64$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $0.4$ | $0.4$ | $0.2$ |
question.worked_solution:
For a discrete random variable $X$ and a function $r(x),$ the rule of the lazy statistician states that 

$$
\text{E}[r(X)]={\sum }_{x\in S}r(x)f(x).
$$

In our case, we have 

$$
r(x)=\sqrt[3]{x}.
$$

 

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[\sqrt[3]{X}] & ={\sum }_{x\in S}\sqrt[3]{x}\,f(x) \\  & =\sqrt[3]{8}\cdot 0.4+\sqrt[3]{27}\cdot 0.4+\sqrt[3]{64}\cdot 0.2 \\  & =2\cdot 0.4+3\cdot 0.4+4\cdot 0.2 \\  & =0.8+1.2+0.8 \\  & =2.8.\end{aligned}
$$
